tools.name: apify_run_actor
tools.description: Run an Apify actor to build a lead list or scrape structured data, wait for it to finish, and return its dataset items as structured JSON. This is the tool for lead generation, prospecting, finding people/companies/contacts, and web scraping — use it instead of web_search whenever the user wants a list of leads, prospects, companies, or contact details. Pass exactly two arguments: `actor_id` (a string) and `input` (an object). Example call: { "actor_id": "apify/google-search-scraper", "input": { "queries": "dentists in Austin TX" } }. The actor's parameters MUST go inside the `input` object, NOT at the top level.

actor_id.description: The Apify actor to run, as a single string in 'username/actor-name' (or 'username~actor-name') form. This is a string, NOT an object.

input.description: The actor's input parameters, as an OBJECT — the exact keys depend on the actor. apify/web-scraper expects `startUrls` (an array of { url } objects); apify/google-search-scraper expects `queries` (a newline-separated string or array); apify/google-maps-scraper expects `searchStringsArray` and `locationQuery`. Put ALL actor parameters inside this object.

wait_seconds.description: Optional. Maximum seconds to wait for the run to finish (default 120, max 600). Increase for large crawls.

max_items.description: Optional. Maximum dataset items to return (default 50, max 1000).
